definition: [ נְחִילָה ] noun feminine meaning unknown; only; plural in phrase אֶלהַֿנְּחִילוֺת Ps 5:1 (title); most conjecture = נְחִלּוֺת √ חלל = חָלִיל flute; see against this Bae Einl. xi , who thinks (compare ᵐ5 ὑπὲρ τῆς Κληρονομούσης = אֶלהַֿנֹּחֶלֶת [compare ᵑ9 ], Jerome [ Aq Symm] pro hereditatibus = אֶלהַֿנְּחָלֹת ) possibly designation of a melody.
